prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1383; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, but I can confirm I was the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision occurred?

A: It was at an intersection in Houston, Texas. I was turning left across the oncoming lanes when another vehicle struck the front passenger side of my car.

Q: Were you turning at a green light or on a green arrow?

A: I had a green light, but the left turn signal had not turned green yet. I was waiting for a gap and started to move when I saw the other car coming.

Q: How fast do you estimate you were moving when the impact happened?

A: Maybe five or ten miles an hour. I had almost stopped. The other driver was coming through fairly quickly, I'd say faster than the posted limit.

Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?

A: I felt stiffness right away but didn't think much of it. By that evening my lower back was really tight and sore, and it's gotten worse when I sit for long periods or lift anything.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic the next day and they diagnosed a back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week and taking over-the-counter pain medication.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: I missed a few shifts while I was recovering and I've been working lighter duties since then. I'm still having some trouble with heavy lifting.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was following the rules of the road and I didn't expect the other car to come through so quickly. I'm willing to provide my medical records.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
